Componente de origen: autocad-mcp
Proyecto: https://github.com/C48H74/autocad-mcp

Los textos originales se reproducen integramente a continuacion. En el aviso
original, "This project" y las afirmaciones sobre su implementacion se refieren
al proyecto autocad-mcp de origen. Su referencia a LICENSE corresponde al texto
MIT reproducido en este mismo documento. Las licencias de otras dependencias
y fuentes incluidas se entregan dentro del paquete instalado.

=== Aviso original de autocad-mcp ===

autocad-mcp
Copyright (c) 2026 Daniel de Souza Paixão. MIT License (see LICENSE).

This project was inspired, at the level of ideas only, by the public repositories listed below.
No source code from any of them was copied; every feature was implemented independently on
top of ezdxf, matplotlib and the Python standard library.

- U-C4N/Autocad-MCP (MIT) - dual COM/DXF backend, dimensions and layouts, tool profiles.
- puran-water/autocad-mcp (MIT) - ezdxf backend, symbol library.
- EmptyKot/acad-cmd (MIT) - command completion, project data dictionaries, audit log.
- daobataotie/cad-mcp (MIT) - screenshot loop, structured tool annotations.
- AnCode666/multiCAD-mcp (Apache-2.0) - unified batch operations, tool grouping.
- zh19980811/easy-mcp-autocad (no license stated) - SQL index of drawing entities (concept only).
- nguyenngocdue/DeepBIM-MCP-Autocad-Plugin (no license stated) - .NET plugin approach (not adopted).

Runtime dependencies keep their own licenses: ezdxf (MIT), matplotlib (PSF-style BSD), openpyxl (MIT),
pydantic (MIT), mcp (MIT), pywin32 (PSF).
AutoCAD is a trademark of Autodesk, Inc.; this project is independent and not affiliated with Autodesk.
